text:
ana_cs: Tessera Labs tripped the APAC (Mumbai) demo limits during a live POC. Theyre asking for a short-lived allowlist + temporary QPS bump and a model pin for the demo. Renewal check in ~5 weeks; theyre nervous. Can ops/infrastructure help?
eden_ops: We can help. Exact region: ap-south-1 (mumbai)?
sachin_net: Yes, they prefer mumbai. Egress IPs: 103.21.55.34 and 103.21.55.35. They also asked to pin model to "open-gpt-small-v1" for the demo to keep outputs predictable.
ana_cs: Customer message pasted: "expected bursts ~320 rps for 2h; request soft QPS=2200 during demo window, hard cap 3000. Please whitelist 103.21.55.0/24 and the two IPs. Need 24h pre-revoke notice and a one-paragraph confirmation email. Also want a short token-cost estimate after demo."
eden_ops: Proposed config: soft=2200 hard=3000, autorevoke @48h, 24h pre-revoke note, model pin open-gpt-small-v1. Need eng-infra approval for region pin + allowlist + model pin.
sachin_net: Minimal infra checklist: 1) add CIDR 103.21.55.0/24 to tenant allowlist 2) add /32s for 103.21.55.34 and .35 to edge ACL 3) set tenant.tessera soft=2200 hard=3000 4) schedule autorevoke @48h 5) pin serving model to open-gpt-small-v1 for tenant during window 6) smoke test from 103.21.55.34
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: draft change scheduled: 2025-05-12T10:00:00Z  status: pending-approval. Change summary: add CIDR 103.21.55.0/24, add egress IPs, soft=2200 hard=3000, autorevoke=48h, model pin=open-gpt-small-v1. Ticket: ENGOPS-5599.
marta_renewals: Flagging renewals  demo outcome directly tied to renewal. Ill prepare the playbook entry to capture post-demo feedback and add a renewal-risk flag if anything looks off.
billing-bot: billing-bot: noted. Well prepare an estimated token-cost delta for the 2h window and send to ana_cs after the demo. Pre-approve up to $90 demo cap per customer request; any overage will require manual sign-off.
sachin_net: Quick validation curl to run after ACL and pin applied:
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Forwarded-For: 103.21.55.34" \
  -H "X-Model-Pin: open-gpt-small-v1" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/healthcheck
```
Expect: 200
eden_ops: Rollback plan: if p50 latency > 500ms OR error rate > 2% over 2m -> revert QPS and model pin, remove temp allowlist, notify CS + customer. We'll also collect token counts and traces during the window.
nana_cs: Customer requested a one-paragraph confirmation email and a 24h pre-revoke notice. Who will own the confirmation and the post-demo feedback capture?
sachin_net: I can draft the confirmation email (will include the test snippet) and post it here for review.
marta_renewals: Ill own the feedback capture and add the result to the renewal playbook immediately after the demo.
ana_cs: Thanks all. Please post status updates in this thread and ping me if approvals block the window. :thumbsup:
